text: 证监会副主席李超10日下午在国新办新闻发布会上表示，进一步提高上市公司质量和投资价值。资本市场高质量发展离不开高质量的上市公司群体。要更大力度释放并购重组改革活力，支持上市公司转型升级、做优做强。提升上市公司治理和规范运作水平，引导上市公司通过股权激励、分红回购等提高自身价值。严格执行并持续完善退市制度。
text_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said on the afternoon of the 10th at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office that the CSRC will further improve the quality and investment value of listed companies. High-quality capital market development cannot be separated from a high-quality group of listed companies. It is necessary to release the vitality of M&A and restructuring reform with greater intensity, and support listed companies in transforming, upgrading, and becoming stronger and better. It will improve the level of corporate governance and standardized operation of listed companies, and guide listed companies to enhance their own value through equity incentives, dividends, and share buybacks. It will strictly implement and continuously improve the delisting system.
